content.text: I will gather system CPU info into temp_cpu_check and produce candidate reconciliation files. Running the collection script now.

arguments:
{"script":"set -eu
WORKDIR=temp_cpu_check
RAW="$WORKDIR/raw_cpu_info.txt"
META="$WORKDIR/metadata.txt"
CAND="$WORKDIR/cpu_count_candidates.txt"
mkdir -p "$WORKDIR"
: > "$RAW"
: > "$META"
: > "$CAND"

ts() { date -u +"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ"; }

append_raw() {
  echo "--- $1 ---" >> "$RAW"
  echo "timestamp: $(ts)" >> "$RAW"
  echo "source: $1" >> "$RAW"
  echo "" >> "$RAW"
  eval "$2" >> "$RAW" 2>&1 || true
  echo "" >> "$RAW"
}

record_meta() {
  echo "$(ts) | $1" >> "$META"
}

# Gather data
append_raw "uname" "uname -a"
record_meta "uname"

append_raw "date" "date -u"
record_meta "date"

append_raw "lscpu" "lscpu"
record_meta "lscpu"

append_raw "nproc" "nproc"
record_meta "nproc"

append_raw "getconf__NPROCESSORS_ONLN" "getconf _NPROCESSORS_ONLN"
record_meta "getconf _NPROCESSORS_ONLN"

append_raw "/proc/cpuinfo" "cat /proc/cpuinfo"
record_meta "/proc/cpuinfo"

append_raw "grep_processor_count" "grep -c '^processor' /proc/cpuinfo || true"
record_meta "grep -c 'processor' /proc/cpuinfo"

append_raw "/sys/devices/system/cpu/online" "cat /sys/devices/system/cpu/online || true"
record_meta "/sys/devices/system/cpu/online"

append_raw "/sys/devices/system/cpu/present" "cat /sys/devices/system/cpu/present || true"
record_meta "/sys/devices/system/cpu/present"

append_raw "sys_cpu_dirs" "ls -d /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpu[0-9]* || true"
record_meta "ls /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpu*"

append_raw "per_cpu_online_files" "for d in /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpu[0-9]*; do if [ -d \"$d\" ]; then echo \"--- $d ---\"; cat \"$d/online\" 2>/dev/null || echo '(no online file)'; fi; done"
record_meta "per-cpu online files"

append_raw "dmidecode_processor" "(which dmidecode >/dev/null 2>&1 && dmidecode -t processor) || echo 'dmidecode: unavailable or no permission'"
record_meta "dmidecode -t processor"

append_raw "dmesg_cpu" "dmesg | egrep -i 'cpu|smp' || true"
record_meta "dmesg grep cpu/smp"

# Compute candidate counts
nproc_val="$(nproc 2>/dev/null || true)"
getconf_val="$(getconf _NPROCESSORS_ONLN 2>/dev/null || true)"
lscpu_val="$(lscpu 2>/dev/null | awk -F: '/^CPU\(s\):/ {gsub(/ /,"",$2); print $2; exit}' || true)"
procinfo_count="$(grep -c '^processor' /proc/cpuinfo 2>/dev/null || true)"
sys_online_raw="$(cat /sys/devices/system/cpu/online 2>/dev/null || true)"
sys_present_raw="$(cat /sys/devices/system/cpu/present 2>/dev/null || true)"

# count cpu dirs
cpu_dir_count="$(ls -d /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpu[0-9]* 2>/dev/null | wc -l || true)"

# count online by per-cpu online files
online_by_files=0
for d in /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpu[0-9]*; do
  if [ -d "$d" ]; then
    f="$d/online"
    if [ -f "$f" ]; then
      v=$(cat "$f" 2>/dev/null || echo '')
      if [ "$v" = "1" ]; then online_by_files=$((online_by_files+1)); fi
    else
      online_by_files=$((online_by_files+1))
    fi
  fi
done

# expand ranges like 0-3,5 to count entries
expand_count() {
  s="$1"
  if [ -z "$s" ]; then echo ""; return; fi
  python3 - <<PY || true
s = "$s"
parts = [p.strip() for p in s.split(',') if p.strip()]
nums = set()
for p in parts:
    if '-' in p:
        a,b = p.split('-',1)
        for i in range(int(a), int(b)+1): nums.add(i)
    else:
        nums.add(int(p))
print(len(nums))
PY
}

online_range_count="$(expand_count "$sys_online_raw" || true)"
present_range_count="$(expand_count "$sys_present_raw" || true)"

# write raw summary of candidates into RAW
{
  echo "--- candidate summary ---"
  echo "timestamp: $(ts)"
  echo "nproc: $nproc_val"
  echo "getconf__NPROCESSORS_ONLN: $getconf_val"
  echo "lscpu_CPUs: $lscpu_val"
  echo "procinfo_processor_count: $procinfo_count"
  echo "sys_online_raw: $sys_online_raw"
  echo "sys_present_raw: $sys_present_raw"
  echo "cpu_dir_count: $cpu_dir_count"
  echo "online_by_files: $online_by_files"
  echo "online_range_count: $online_range_count"
  echo "present_range_count: $present_range_count"
  echo "" >> "$RAW"
} >> "$RAW"

# Prepare candidates file with reconciliation notes
{
  echo "# CPU count candidates (normalized integers)"
  echo "# source: value"
  [ -n "$nproc_val" ] && echo "nproc: $nproc_val"
  [ -n "$getconf_val" ] && echo "getconf__NPROCESSORS_ONLN: $getconf_val"
  [ -n "$lscpu_val" ] && echo "lscpu__CPUs: $lscpu_val"
  [ -n "$procinfo_count" ] && echo "procinfo_processor_count: $procinfo_count"
  [ -n "$online_range_count" ] && echo "sys_cpu_online_range_count: $online_range_count"
  [ -n "$present_range_count" ] && echo "sys_cpu_present_range_count: $present_range_count"
  [ -n "$cpu_dir_count" ] && echo "sys_cpu_dir_count: $cpu_dir_count"
  echo "sys_online_by_per_cpu_files: $online_by_files"
  echo ""
  echo "# Reconciliation notes:"
  echo "# - Values may differ due to offline CPUs, hotplug, cgroups/containers, or permission-limited tools."
  echo "# - 'procinfo_processor_count' counts logical processors listed in /proc/cpuinfo."
  echo "# - 'nproc' and 'getconf _NPROCESSORS_ONLN' reflect online logical processors visible to the current environment."
  echo "# - 'lscpu' reports architecture view which may include sockets/cores/threads." 
  echo "# - sysfs 'online'/'present' provide hardware-visible ranges; present may include CPUs that are present but offline."
  echo "# - per-cpu online files were read; when absent, CPU was assumed online (typical for cpu0)."
  echo ""

  # Aggregate unique candidate values
  echo "# Unique numeric candidates:"
  echo "$(printf "%s\n" "$nproc_val" "$getconf_val" "$lscpu_val" "$procinfo_count" "$online_range_count" "$present_range_count" "$cpu_dir_count" "$online_by_files" | grep -E '^[0-9]+' | sort -n | uniq -c | awk '{print $2" (count:"$1")"}')"
  echo ""

  # Choose primary candidate
  # Preference: online_by_files (most direct), then online_range_count, then getconf/nproc, then procinfo, then lscpu, then cpu_dir_count
  primary_src=""
  primary_val=""
  if [ -n "$online_by_files" ] && [ "$online_by_files" -gt 0 ] 2>/dev/null; then
    primary_src="sys_online_by_per_cpu_files"
    primary_val="$online_by_files"
  elif [ -n "$online_range_count" ] && [ "$online_range_count" -gt 0 ] 2>/dev/null; then
    primary_src="sys_cpu_online_range_count"
    primary_val="$online_range_count"
  elif [ -n "$getconf_val" ]; then
    primary_src="getconf__NPROCESSORS_ONLN"
    primary_val="$getconf_val"
  elif [ -n "$nproc_val" ]; then
    primary_src="nproc"
    primary_val="$nproc_val"
  elif [ -n "$procinfo_count" ]; then
    primary_src="procinfo_processor_count"
    primary_val="$procinfo_count"
  elif [ -n "$lscpu_val" ]; then
    primary_src="lscpu__CPUs"
    primary_val="$lscpu_val"
  else
    primary_src="none_detected"
    primary_val=""
  fi

  echo "# Primary candidate (selected for final reporting, do NOT output final number here):"
  if [ -n "$primary_val" ]; then
    echo "Primary candidate source: $primary_src"
    echo "Primary candidate value: $primary_val"
  else
    echo "Primary candidate: none"
  fi
} > "$CAND"

# Final metadata note
echo "collection_completed: $(ts)" >> "$META"

# Minimal verification: list files
ls -l "$WORKDIR"
"}
